title: AgentOpenrouterProvider
description:
Provider routing preferences.

Controls which providers are used and in what order when routing
requests to upstream model hosts.

allow_fallbacks.description:
Whether to allow fallback to other providers if preferred ones fail.
Defaults to `true`.

require_parameters.description:
Whether to require that the provider supports all request parameters.
Defaults to `false`.

order.description: Preferred provider order. Earlier providers are tried first.

only.description: Exclusive list of allowed providers. If set, only these providers are used.
